Ava (Marketing): Draft is live in the doc: https://docs.google.com/example. Focus: Optimize launch, conservative benchmark line, tiny embeddings example, and CTA routing. Need legal + sales by EOD.

Diego (Content): Pasting short embed snippet to include so devs can copy: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' -d '{\"model\":\"open-embed-lite\",\"input\":\"Why use Redwood Optimize\"}'
```

Nina (Legal): Quick pass: remove hard numeric claims (e.g., "5x") unless cited; change to "reduces per-token cost through batching and caching". Also reword SLA mentions to "where contracted". Approve after edits.

Sam (Sales): CTA routing: Request a demo -> HubSpot hb-410 (AE); Try Hosted API -> /signup?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=optimize_launch (growth); Webinar -> Eventbrite -> HubSpot list (tag: webinar_reg). Ops note: if registrant.company_size > 50 AND role in [\"Eng\",\"Product\",\"ML\"], mark high-priority and create AE task.

Ava (Marketing): Updated language per legal, added CTA mapping and ops note. Please drop a :thumbsup: when CMS matches doc.

Nina (Legal): :thumbsup: approved (CMS copy must match doc).

Sam (Sales): :thumbsup: approved.

Ava (Marketing): Thanks all
